purpose: Authoring alignment guide; the source WAD remains the rendering oracle.
workflow: Compose on the matching SVG canvas at its declared pixel size.
Keep the guide in a separate, hidden layer when exporting final artwork.
Use a transparent, non-interlaced RGBA PNG with declared dimensions matching the channel layout.
Validate with wm-channels validate FOLDER, install with wm-channels add FOLDER, and inspect with wm-channels preview ID.
Compare a rendered frame with the same aspect ratio and frame of the source WAD before claiming one-to-one fidelity.
limitations: The red rounded paths are alignment overlays, not extracted mask textures.
Custom channel logic and native module scripts are not reproduced by the authored layout format.
The C runtime accepts vector panes and non-interlaced RGBA PNG textures; SVG is an authoring guide, not a runtime texture.
